review_evidence: README identifies the repository as the Lean 4 formalization of the Polynomial Freiman–Ruzsa conjecture proof, together with later extensions around entropy and related additive-combinatorial arguments.
The 75 current-primary Lean files include the PFR theorem chain, entropy/Ruzsa-distance infrastructure, examples and project-local ForMathlib/Mathlib extensions with reusable lemmas and instances.

Challenge/Solution and Mathlib-path modules contain formal statements/proofs or supporting interfaces; names suggesting examples, challenge material or upstream-style support therefore do not establish content-lossless exclusions.
summary: Retain the complete PFR formalization and supporting project-local library material; no safe hard exclusion was established.

review_evidence: Ran a Lean declaration-marker grep (theorem|lemma|def|structure|inductive|class|instance|abbrev|macro|elab|syntax|axiom, unanchored) across all 12 files: scores ranged from 0 (`PFR.lean`, `PFR/Examples.lean`) to 86 (`PFR/RhoFunctional.lean`); two zero-hit files required full reads.

Read `PFR.lean` in full (2941 bytes, 0 hits): 73 `import` lines only, listing every module of the PFR project -- a FILTER-007 pure root import aggregator, no declarations of its own. Retained, no exclusion rule needed.

Read `PFR/Examples.lean` in full (8987 bytes, 0 hits under the theorem/lemma/def keyword set): a dense sequence of `example` statements (a Lean declaration keyword this session's grep set omitted) demonstrating each of the project's main results in self-contained form -- the PFR conjecture and its improved/torsion/weak/homomorphism variants, entropy/mutual-information/Ruzsa-distance notation illustrations, and `#guard_msgs in #print axioms` checks confirming each theorem's axiom dependencies. Genuine, substantial worked-example content specifically curated to showcase the library for readers; not a pure aggregator. Retained.

The remaining 10 files (`ApproxHomPFR.lean`, `EntropyPFR.lean`, `ImprovedPFR.lean`, `Main.lean`, three small `PFR/Mathlib/...` upstreaming files, `RhoFunctional.lean`, `TorsionEndgame.lean`, `WeakPFR.lean`) all scored 1-86 declaration markers and hold real Polynomial-Freiman-Ruzsa formalization content consistent with the prior review's retain disposition; no file matched a known exclusion pattern from this session's precedents.
